Combat Guide
There are several ways to deal damage and a few more for preventing it. These can be with magic, tech, or even just raw force. These are compiled below.
General Strategies
Outside of just having tons of materials, there are also strategies to be employed, they can be found here.
Dealing Damage
Artifact/Brute Force Damaging:
<big><u>3 Primary Methods here</u></big>
Feral Claws- Increases your attacks speed by a flat +0.4.

Mass Gauntlet - Adds flat damage to your attack based on your max HP, with the maximum level adding 17.91% of your max HP as flat damage to your attacks(in actuality being 14.95%). For example if you would have 20 max HP, it would add +2.99 attack damage to your base damage.
Soldier's syringe - Adds +20% attack speed.
Still Beating Heart - Provides a +20% attack damage increase only at full health and a flat +2 attack damage increase
Guts Orb - Provides up to 1.65× multiplier on your attack damage, if you are on fire or under a negative effect(a good combination with the Stillness Scarf or the Ring of the Seven Curses)
Magma Stone - Gives a 1.2× multiplier on your attack damage.
Charm of Hell Blade - Gives a 100% increase to your Attack damage, but decreases your armor by -100%.
Chthonic Cursemark - 1.5× multiplier to all damage dealt by you, but 2× damage taken from all sources
Proximity badge - 1.5× multiplier to all Damage dealt by you in close range(<3m), but ×1.66 multiplier to all damage taken from a distance(>3m)
Dueling Glove - 1.5× multiplier to all damage dealt by you to the nearest mob, but 1.5× damage taken from other mobs.

Brutal Heart - Converts Health lost into Crit Chance at a ratio of 1 Heart to 10% Crit Chance, -25% Total Max HP, +25% Base Crit Damage and +?% Base Crit Chance, where ? equals the amount of Max HP lost, example being: You have 20 Max HP, so then equipping this artifact would grant you +33.33% Crit Chance.
Weapons
Born in Chaos charms, dropped by Missionaries.
Using Enigmatic Dice, which can give permanent status effects, with the combination of The Cloud item from Brutality can save the status effects even in the case of death.

In the case of using the Ring of the Seven Curses, a player can make the Divine Fruit Pie, which combined with the aforementioned Cloud item can give the player permanent Health Boost 5, Strength 3, Resistance 2 and Regeneration.

Preventing Damage
There are a plethora of defensive items in this modpack, yet not every single one is very useful. So, this section is going to list the best ones.
All around Protection/Damage Reduction:
Prismatic Scarf - Grants you 15% Damage Reduction.
Exodium Shield Amulet - Grants you 25% Damage Reduction, in turn you deal only 0.8× of your original damage.
All Purpose Seasoning - When you eat, you recover 1 HP and an additionally recover 2 food levels.
Solar Safeguard Pendant - +4 Max HP, saves the user when falling into the void, heals half a heart while on fire and gives complete fire immunity
Celestial Brew - gives +4 Max HP
Second Heart - gives +12 Max HP
Etherium Core - +12 armor, +10 armor toughness, along with a +20% armor increase and a 40% armor toughness increase.
Doppelganger ring - +30 Max HP and +150 Max Mana
Made in Heaven - Multiplies your stats to up to 1.4×, protects you from death with a cooldown and has an ability to deal a percentage of enemies Max HP.
Non-Euclidean Cube - Makes you practically immortal.
Blessed - weapon enchantment that has a chance on hit to heal 0.5 health per enchantment level

Enhanced Protection - The formula for damage reduction is (5 × level)% for each armor piece, for a maximum damage reduction of 80% if all armor pieces are enchanted with Enhanced Protection IV.(Side note: Maximum achievable damage reduction from Enhanced Protection is 80%, meaning even with higher levels of Enhanced Protection, it will NOT increase past 80%).
